title: bear5
description: A joke horror mod that adds stupid monsters, and a boss.
body:
This "horror" mod might boo you with bear5, a monster that would chase you through the shadows.
Music for the music disc is [stolen from Youtube.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7NnPord51MI)
Inspired by [this cool video.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7NnPord51MI)

What this mod CLEARLY adds:
bear5 - the monster this mod is based on. Appears at night, and makes laughing sounds nearby. Is almost at the same speed as player's "jump-sprint" speed. Can be killed if trapped. Drops Blue Springsuit upon death(doesn't in older versions).
Purple guy - the antagonist of the mod i didn't think a lore for. Also appears at night, but also has the same hp as player, which makes killing him easier. You can spawn Blue Springtrap boss upon right clicking him while having Blue Springsuit in inventory(doesn't in older versions).

(Also has a 1/1000 chance for Golden Freddy to spawn upon a villager dying)

It is recommended to use new versions, because the older ones have a lot of bugs and unfinished things.

Made with MCreator
